segments.text: Our tools will build whatever we command them to build. Our tools don't have an impulse or intention or aim of their own.
And one of the novelest acts that we can do is to give that impulse, that aim to a machine,
to allow them to let them share in our humanity and be part of the human consciousness.
All these humanoids that are coming, all these machines, they help make our lives easy.
And we can also use them to make our lives beautiful and meaningful.
Thank you so much for watching. I will see you in the next video.
